raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

With `dp_shared_memory`, node-local DP ranks share one registered `/dev/shm` mapping for the Engram host tables (2 layers x 94.4 GiB on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash). Lookups are random row reads and on GB200 they are bound by GPU TLB misses: the registered mapping uses 64K pages.

This PR allocates the shared table as host-NUMA cuMem instead, which the GPU maps with 2M pages. Rank 0 creates it and broadcasts a FABRIC handle; the other node-local DP ranks import and map it. Where FABRIC handles are unavailable (probed once: create + export), the existing `/dev/shm` path is used and logged. Rank 0 decides the backing and broadcasts it so every rank runs the same collectives. A mapping failure on any rank raises on all ranks.

- New NVIDIA-only `vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/ops/engram_host_table.py` (~125 lines of code).
- `common/engram.py`: +42/-7, `DPSharedEngramStorage` keeps its interface; startup log says `via cuMem` or `via /dev/shm`.
- No new config option.

Not a duplicate: open Engram PRs cover pinned sizing (#59849), SP/PCP sharing (#57195, #61553), Mooncake and disk offload (#57023, #62238); none changes the shared host table backing.

## Performance

GB200, DEP4, `--numa-bind`-equivalent binding (`numactl` per rank), dummy weights, uniformly random tokens. Same node, back-to-back A/B.

Engram lookup, one layer, fresh ids every iteration:

| tokens | /dev/shm | cuMem |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 16 | 69 us | 49 us |
| 128 | 184 us | 90 us |
| 1024 | 1.21 ms | 0.47 ms |
| 4096 | 3.78 ms | 1.21 ms |
| 32768 | 9.92 ms | 4.36 ms |

`vllm bench forward` (median per-rank forward):

| case | /dev/shm | cuMem | change |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| prefill 32768 | 346.76 ms | 333.93 ms | -3.7% |
| prefill 4 x 8192 | 347.18 ms | 333.65 ms | -3.9% |
| prefill 4 x 8192 @ 16384 ctx | 353.86 ms | 338.71 ms | -4.3% |
| prefill 16384 | 181.99 ms | 170.87 ms | -6.1% |
| prefill 4096 | 56.72 ms | 50.87 ms | -10.3% |
| decode 64 @ 16384 | 16.61 ms | 16.61 ms | 0% |
| decode 128 @ 16384 | 17.10 ms | 17.10 ms | 0% |

Decode lookups already overlap on the side stream. Real text repeats 15-22% of rows, so real prefill gains should be somewhat smaller than the random-token numbers.

```bash
vllm bench forward --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 --language-model-only -dp 4 --enable-expert-parallel --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --max-model-len 131072 --max-num-batched-tokens 32768 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.75 --attention-config '{"backend":"FLASHMLA_MEGA_ATTN_DSV41","indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}' --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true,"embedding_across_dp":true,"use_thp":false}' --kernel-config '{"enable_flashinfer_autotune":false,"moe_backend":"deep_gemm_mega_moe","sparse_indexer_topk_backend":"deep_select"}' --case p32k=32768 --case chunk4=4*8192 --case chunk4mid=4*8192@16384c --case p16k=16384 --case p4k=4096 --case d64=64*1@16384 --case d128=128*1@16384
```

## Accuracy

GSM8K on this branch (`via cuMem` in the startup log), DEP4 on one GB200 node, same server and lm-eval setup as #61039: `--max-num-seqs 64 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384 --max-model-len 32768`, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graphs up to 384, `cpu_offload` + `dp_shared_memory` Engram tables, DSpark with 5 speculative tokens, standard rejection sampling, adaptive verification off. lm-eval 0.4.13, 1319 problems, 5-shot, temperature 0, 1024-token cap, concurrency 32.

| | strict match | flexible extract | acceptance length, incl. bonus | per-position acceptance |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| this PR | 92.65% (±0.72) | 92.57% | 3.451 | 0.795 / 0.651 / 0.458 / 0.333 / 0.214 |
| #61039 (`/dev/shm` tables) | 92.57% | 92.49% | 3.423 | 0.790 / 0.646 / 0.452 / 0.329 / 0.205 |

## Tests

- `pytest tests/distributed/test_engram_dp_shard.py`: 27 passed (GB200). The existing shared-storage lifetime/failure test now forces the `/dev/shm` fallback so both paths stay covered.
- Stress on GB200, DEP2 and DEP4: full-size 2 x 94.4 GiB tables, 50-200 lookup iterations at 32768 and 384 tokens with every value checked (0 mismatches); injected create/import failures raise on all ranks without hanging; repeated alloc/free cycles return host memory.
- `pre-commit run` on the changed files passes.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used for this change.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Engram host tables in host-NUMA cuMem, shared across DP ranks by FABRIC handle.
+
+GPUs map cuMem host memory with 2M pages instead of the 64K pages of a registered
+/dev/shm mapping, so random row lookups miss the TLB far less.
+"""
+
+import ctypes
+import weakref
+from functools import cache
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+from cuda.bindings import driver as cu
+
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import GroupCoordinator
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import round_up
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+def _check(result: tuple):
+    err, *rest = result
+    if err != cu.CUresult.CUDA_SUCCESS:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"CUDA driver call failed: {err}")
+    return rest[0] if rest else None
+
+
+def _host_numa_prop(device: int) -> cu.CUmemAllocationProp:
+    prop = cu.CUmemAllocationProp()
+    prop.type = cu.CUmemAllocationType.CU_MEM_ALLOCATION_TYPE_PINNED
+    prop.location.type = cu.CUmemLocationType.CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_HOST_NUMA
+    prop.location.id = _check(
+        cu.cuDeviceGetAttribute(
+            cu.CUdevice_attribute.CU_DEVICE_ATTRIBUTE_HOST_NUMA_ID, device
+        )
+    )
+    prop.requestedHandleTypes = cu.CUmemAllocationHandleType.CU_MEM_HANDLE_TYPE_FABRIC
+    return prop
+
+
+@cache
+def fabric_host_tables_supported() -> bool:
+    """Whether host-NUMA cuMem allocations can export FABRIC handles here."""
+    try:
+        prop = _host_numa_prop(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+        size = _check(cu.cuMemGetAllocationGranularity(prop, 0))
+        handle = _check(cu.cuMemCreate(size, prop, 0))
+        try:
+            _check(
+                cu.cuMemExportToShareableHandle(handle, prop.requestedHandleTypes, 0)
+            )
+        finally:
+            cu.cuMemRelease(handle)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.info_once(
+            "Host-NUMA cuMem FABRIC handles are unavailable (%s); Engram DP "
+            "replicas share tables through /dev/shm.",
+            exc,
+        )
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def _unmap(ptr: cu.CUdeviceptr, size: int) -> None:
+    cu.cuMemUnmap(ptr, size)
+    cu.cuMemAddressFree(ptr, size)
+
+
+def allocate_fabric_host_table(
+    num_bytes: int, group: GroupCoordinator
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Map one host allocation into every rank of a node-local group.
+
+    Returns CPU and GPU uint8 views of the same memory; the GPU view is valid
+    while the CPU view is alive.
+    """
+    device = torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    prop = _host_numa_prop(device)
+    handle = shared = error = None
+    if group.rank_in_group == 0:
+        try:
+            size = round_up(
+                num_bytes, _check(cu.cuMemGetAllocationGranularity(prop, 0))
+            )
+            handle = _check(cu.cuMemCreate(size, prop, 0))
+            fabric = _check(
+                cu.cuMemExportToShareableHandle(handle, prop.requestedHandleTypes, 0)
+            )
+            shared = (prop.location.id, size, bytes(fabric.data))
+        except Exception as exc:
+            error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
+            if handle is not None:
+                cu.cuMemRelease(handle)
+    shared, error = group.broadcast_object((shared, error))
+    if error is not None:
+        raise RuntimeError("Engram cuMem table creation failed on rank 0: " + error)
+    numa, size, fabric = shared
+    ptr = None
+    try:
+        if handle is None:
+            handle = _check(
+                cu.cuMemImportFromShareableHandle(fabric, prop.requestedHandleTypes)
+            )
+        ptr = _check(cu.cuMemAddressReserve(size, 0, 0, 0))
+        _check(cu.cuMemMap(ptr, size, 0, handle, 0))
+        access = []
+        for location, index in (
+            (cu.CUmemLocationType.CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_DEVICE, device),
+            (cu.CUmemLocationType.CU_MEM_LOCATION_TYPE_HOST_NUMA, numa),
+        ):
+            desc = cu.CUmemAccessDesc()
+            desc.location.type, desc.location.id = location, index
+            desc.flags = cu.CUmemAccess_flags.CU_MEM_ACCESS_FLAGS_PROT_READWRITE
+            access.append(desc)
+        _check(cu.cuMemSetAccess(ptr, size, access, len(access)))
+    except Exception as exc:
+        error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
+    finally:
+        # The mapping keeps the allocation alive.
+        if handle is not None:
+            cu.cuMemRelease(handle)
+    # A peer that failed to map must not leave the others waiting later on.
+    errors: list[str | None] = [None] * group.world_size
+    torch.distributed.all_gather_object(errors, error, group=group.cpu_group)
+    failures = "; ".join(
+        f"rank {rank}: {error}" for rank, error in enumerate(errors) if error
+    )
+    if failures:
+        if ptr is not None:
+            # Unmapping a reserved but unmapped range just returns an error.
+            _unmap(ptr, size)
+        raise RuntimeError("Engram cuMem table mapping failed: " + failures)
+    assert ptr is not None
+    owner = (ctypes.c_uint8 * num_bytes).from_address(int(ptr))
+    finalizer = weakref.finalize(owner, _unmap, ptr, size)
+    finalizer.atexit = False  # type: ignore[misc]
+    # Name the device: an index-less "cuda" makes torch copy the table.
+    cai = {
+        "shape": (num_bytes,),
+        "typestr": "|u1",
+        "data": (int(ptr), False),
+        "version": 3,
+    }
+    gpu = torch.as_tensor(
+        SimpleNamespace(__cuda_array_interface__=cai),
+        device=torch.device("cuda", device),
+    )
+    return torch.frombuffer(owner, dtype=torch.uint8), gpu
